title: Making a game with AI for the first time
author: Perfect-Spinach3364
selftext:
I’ve been planning this for a bit, I’ve been pretty bored with no other hobbies, just working and school, but I’ve always liked playing games, so recently I started planning my own game.

It’s very ambitious, and I’ve estimated the amount of time it’ll take to be around 3-4 years, but I’m glad to do it, it’s a knight game, low poly single player story, one decently big map with 4 main places, to not give so many details, it’ll be around 20?-25? Hours long is what I’m aiming for, and I just came here to ask is this even achievable or possible to do just with AI? I’ll be building the map and stuff mostly on my own, but the scripting is what I’m worried about and don’t even know if AI really is that advanced yet, I’m in unreal engine and using blueprint to code

comments.author: Microtom_
comments.body: Coding is the easiest part now. What takes a lot of time is the art and animations, because the AI tools for that aren't good enough.
